data.title: 墨染希 · 留给你的那只面包
data.description: 从面包店出来，希忍不住先掰开一只热面包。她把较大的一半连同纸袋递向你，自己那半还冒着一点热气。
data.promptProse: Outside a neighborhood bakery, Nozomi wears a honey cardigan and straight jeans. She offers the viewer half of a freshly split bread roll on its paper bag, holding the other half close to her chest. The shop window catches the late-morning light.
data.animaCaption: The larger bread half rests on the paper bag extended toward the viewer.
data.action: 把刚掰开的热面包递给你
